description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is hiring an early-career software engineer to develop and support its software products. The role includes work across C#/.NET services, TypeScript and Vue front ends, mobile applications, databases, and Azure infrastructure, with mentorship from experienced team members.
Junior Software Engineer building full-stack products with C#/.NET, TypeScript and Vue, supporting Azure infrastructure and API design

Responsibilities:
• Write, develop, and ship C#/.NET code for company products
• Build and maintain front-end features using TypeScript and Vue
• Work across the full technology stack, including databases, web servers, networks, and front-end applications
• Help maintain and improve Microsoft Azure infrastructure
• Read and review code written by other developers, including offshore development teams
• Contribute to technical specifications, architecture discussions, and API design
• Troubleshoot and provide basic product support, both in-house and through remote sessions
• Ask questions, explore solutions, and take initiative while working with guidance from experienced team members

Requirements:
• Comfortable working in Linux, including navigating file systems, using Bash, and working in a terminal
• Working knowledge of Git, preferably through the command line, including commits, branches, merges, pull requests, and local versus remote repositories
• Productive experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Ruby
• Demonstrated programming ability in at least one substantial language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, C, C++, Java, Rust, or Go
• Evidence of building something end to end through a personal project, internship, coursework, open-source contribution, or similar experience
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Authorization to work in the United States

Preferred:
• Full-stack experience integrating software across a network, from database to web server to front end
• Experience with multiple scripting languages
• Publicly available code through platforms such as GitHub or GitLab, or technical writing through a blog
• A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, chemistry, or another hard science
